Title: [Eligibility][Response] Verify Eligibility on a ticketed booked PNR returns isChangeable = true and changes nothing.

Title: [Eligibility]&[Reshop][Response] Verify held, voided and cancelled bookings get isChangeable = true from Eligibility today and are rejected by Reshop.
Preconditions: Three bookings on OmanAirV17/EGY on stg-ne-2 (Re-Issue collection environment; confirm before the run): (a) Held, not ticketed (SPEC §2.10); (b) ticketed then voided (SPEC §2.15); (c) Held then CancelAfterHold.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. POST Eligibility for (a), (b), (c). 2. POST Reshop (date change) for each. 3. Retrieve each.
Expected Result: Eligibility HTTP 200 with isChangeable = true for each (SPEC §2.16: it does not evaluate the booking yet). Reshop (or at the latest Exchange) rejects each booking with 4xx in the standard envelope (Q13, Q20); no ticket is reissued.
SpecReference: AC-08; AN#23; Q13, Q20; Coll: Postman_Collection/Re-Issue, folder 5. Reissue/Eligibility; SPEC §2.16
Notes: Type: Negative | Technique: EP, ST | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection. When Eligibility starts evaluating bookings, expect false here and update the row.

Title: [Eligibility]&[Reshop][Request] Verify Reshop is rejected for a booking that Eligibility reports as not changeable.
Capabilities / Test Data: Same booking keys in both calls.
Preconditions: Booking where Eligibility returns isChangeable = false (from TC-RI-ELIG-NEG-01 or a non-changeable fare).
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. Eligibility -> isChangeable = false. 2. POST Reshop anyway. 3. Retrieve.
Expected Result: Reshop rejected with 4xx (INFERRED: Eligibility and Reshop must agree; the collection describes Eligibility as the gate that stops the flow). Original PNR and tickets unchanged: Retrieve on the original pnr returns the same itinerary, tickets[] and priceDetails as before the call; no reissued ticket is created.
SpecReference: AC-05; Q13; Coll: Postman_Collection/Re-Issue, folder 5. Reissue/Eligibility, /Reshop; SPEC §2.16
Notes: Type: Negative | Technique: ST, DT | Gate G4 - BLOCKED: Eligibility always returns true today (SPEC §2.16), so isChangeable = false cannot be produced. Run when Eligibility evaluates bookings.
